entries.solutionCode:
def Compress(text: str) -> str:
    parts = []
    start = 0
    while start < len(text):
        end = start + 1
        while end < len(text) and text[end] == text[start]:
            end += 1
        parts.append(text[start])
        parts.append(str(end - start))
        start = end
    output = "".join(parts)
    return output if len(output) < len(text) else text

entries.signature: def AddLists(first: LinkedListNode | None, second: LinkedListNode | None, mostSignificantFirst: bool) -> LinkedListNode | None
entries.solutionCode:
def AddLists(
    first: LinkedListNode | None, second: LinkedListNode | None, mostSignificantFirst: bool
) -> LinkedListNode | None:
    if mostSignificantFirst:
        left, right = [], []
        current = first
        while current is not None:
            left.append(current.Value)
            current = current.Next
        current = second
        while current is not None:
            right.append(current.Value)
            current = current.Next
        result, carry = None, 0
        while left or right or carry:
            total = carry + (left.pop() if left else 0) + (right.pop() if right else 0)
            result = LinkedListNode(total % 10, result)
            carry = total // 10
        return result
    dummy = LinkedListNode(0)
    tail = dummy
    p, q, carry = first, second, 0
    while p is not None or q is not None or carry:
        total = carry
        if p is not None:
            total += p.Value
            p = p.Next
        if q is not None:
            total += q.Value
            q = q.Next
        tail.Next = LinkedListNode(total % 10)
        tail = tail.Next
        carry = total // 10
    return dummy.Next

entries.solutionCode:
def InsertBits(word: int, insert: int, low: int, high: int) -> int:
    width = high - low + 1
    mask = (1 << width) - 1
    bits = ((word & 0xFFFFFFFF) & ~(mask << low)) | ((insert & mask) << low)
    return bits if bits < 0x80000000 else bits - 0x100000000

def DrawHorizontalLine(screen: bytearray, width: int, x1: int, x2: int, y: int) -> None:
    first, last = x1 // 8, x2 // 8
    row = y * (width // 8)
    for byte in range(first, last + 1):
        start = x1 % 8 if byte == first else 0
        end = x2 % 8 if byte == last else 7
        mask = (255 >> start) & ((255 << (7 - end)) & 255)
        screen[row + byte] |= mask
